items.title: Cardinals Extend Center Hjalte Froholdt Through 2028
items.one_line: Hjalte Froholdt, the steady 'desert Viking,' just put pen to paper on a deal that keeps him anchoring Arizona's line for years to come.

items.title: Packers Coach Proposes Brotherly Showdown at Joint Practice
items.one_line: If things heat up during Wednesday's joint practice, Packers coach Matt LaFleur has a fun fix: tag him in for a midfield tussle with Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur, his younger brother.

items.title: Penix Jr. Emerges as Falcons' QB Favorite Over Tagovailoa
items.one_line: With the regular season looming, Michael Penix Jr. has charged back from injury, tilting the Falcons' quarterback battle in his favor after Tua Tagovailoa's shaky camp.

items.title: Ravens OC Declan Doyle Chooses Booth for Play-Calling
items.one_line: Declan Doyle tested the field and the booth during preseason, then picked his spot: upstairs with a clear view and smooth chats with Lamar Jackson.

items.title: Lamar Jackson Shares Lessons on Patience and Family Focus
items.one_line: Lamar Jackson looked back on choosing long-term NFL dreams over quick cash from his neighborhood friends, crediting his mom's hard work for keeping him on track.

items.title: Bills Name Alec Anderson Starting Left Guard for 2026
items.one_line: Alec Anderson, the undrafted UCLA grad who's grinded his way up Buffalo's depth chart, just got the call: he's the Bills' starting left guard.

items.title: Bills Hold Out Key Players from Tuesday Practice Amid Injury Management
items.one_line: With the regular season just around the corner, the Buffalo Bills kept a slew of starters sidelined Tuesday to play it safe on injuries.

items.title: Josh Allen Sits Out Bills' Preseason Finale vs. Steelers
items.one_line: Josh Allen's preseason wraps up on a high note, with coach Joe Brady praising his sharp command of the offense and hinting at sideline play-calling.

items.title: Bears Exploring Trade Options for Gervon Dexter After Early Practice Exit
items.one_line: Gervon Dexter, the 24-year-old defensive tackle with 13.5 career sacks, left practice early Tuesday, handing first-team reps to rookie Jordan van den Berg and fueling trade buzz.

items.title: Bears Activate Elliott and Hicks, Trim Roster Ahead of Deadline
items.one_line: Head coach Ben Johnson shared that linebackers Keyshaun Elliott and safety Elijah Hicks will return soon, easing some roster worries as cuts loom.

items.title: Bears Still Searching for Left Tackle Starter Before Opener
items.one_line: With the Carolina Panthers game just days away, Bears coach Ben Johnson admits no clear left tackle has emerged from a heated competition.

items.title: Bengals Release Veteran Lineman Cody Ford Ahead of Roster Cuts
items.one_line: Cody Ford's time with the Bengals came to an end just days before final cuts, after a tough training camp where he shuffled between positions.

items.title: C.J. Uzomah Retires as Cincinnati Bengal After 10 NFL Seasons
items.one_line: C.J. Uzomah returned to Cincinnati, the city that drafted him, to hang up his cleats where it all began—surrounded by family and the stripes he loves.

items.title: Browns Name Watson Week 1 Starter Over Sanders, Fans Protest
items.one_line: Signs plastered on the Jim Brown statue captured fans' raw anger: '$280,000,000 27+ VICTIMS ZERO SUPPORTERS' and calls for Watson to leave town.

items.title: Browns Bench Sanders and Watson for Preseason Finale QB Evaluations

items.title: Dae'Quan Wright Set to Return to College Football from NFL with LSU
items.one_line: Dae'Quan Wright's whirlwind NFL stint ends with a historic pivot back to college, reuniting him with coach Lane Kiffin at LSU just before their Clemson opener.

items.title: Navajo Rookie Shiyazh Pete Delivers Stirring Cowboys Locker Room Speech
items.one_line: After just six snaps in a preseason win, undrafted rookie Shiyazh Pete stepped up to address the Dallas Cowboys locker room—and his words about brotherhood left everyone fired up.

items.title: Broncos Sign UFL Pass Rusher Ron Stone Jr., Waive Hakeem Butler
items.one_line: Ron Stone Jr. wasted no time making plays in his first Broncos practice, earning quick praise from the defensive coordinator.

items.title: Lions Star Sam LaPorta Returns to Practice After Hip Injury
items.one_line: Sam LaPorta hit the field in Allen Park, snagging a deep out from Jared Goff like old times. After days of worry, the All-Pro tight end moved smoothly through team drills.

items.title: Dan Campbell Gives Latest on Lions Injuries Ahead of Preseason Finale
items.one_line: Dan Campbell kept it straightforward in his presser: Kerby Joseph's knee rehab is steady, but he's still not back with the team just yet.

items.title: NFC North and AFC South Teams Unveil Rivalries Alternate Uniforms

items.title: Packers Coach Proposes Brotherly Showdown at Joint Practice

items.one_line: Houston's new Texans jerseys capture the city's street art and curb tiles in sharp white and H-Town Blue, drawing cheers from local fans and sharp pushback from Titans supporters.

items.title: Colts Unveil Anvil Strike Rivalries Uniforms with Metallic Blue Helmet
items.one_line: The Colts just dropped their bold new Anvil Strike uniforms, complete with a shiny metallic blue helmet that captures the spark of their pregame anvil ritual at Lucas Oil Stadium.

items.title: Colts Get Good Injury News on Pierce and Ward Ahead of Preseason Finale
items.one_line: Colts coach Shane Steichen delivered smiles with word that wide receiver Alec Pierce could return to practice this week after offseason ankle surgery.

items.title: Jaguars WR Parker Washington Returns to Practice Before Joint Sessions
items.one_line: Parker Washington grabbed a touchdown, then locked facemasks with a Buccaneers cornerback in a heated push—showing he's fully back in the mix.

items.title: Bucs Out-Physicaled in Heated Joint Practice with Jags
items.one_line: Baker Mayfield didn't sugarcoat it after Tuesday's joint practice: the Jaguars played with fire, and Tampa Bay got out-physicaled in a session marked by a scuffle.

items.title: Buccaneers Rookie Ted Hurst Outshines Travis Hunter in Joint Practice
items.one_line: Ted Hurst III sprinted downfield in his white No. 11 jersey, snagging passes and leaving Jaguars star Travis Hunter in the dust during Tuesday's joint practice.

items.title: Chiefs Fans Reject Special Teams Talk for Rookie Delane
items.one_line: Dave Toub spotted talent in rookie Mansoor Delane during practice, but Chiefs fans want no part of him on special teams.

items.title: Chiefs Rookie QB Garrett Nussmeier Impresses in Preseason
items.one_line: Garrett Nussmeier stepped up in the pocket, dodged pressure, and fired a sharp pass that had fans buzzing about his future with the Chiefs.

items.title: Davante Adams Shines in Rams Joint Practices, Draws 'Uncoverable' Praise
items.one_line: Davante Adams, now 33 and in a Rams jersey, left defenders grasping at air during joint practices with the Cowboys and Saints. His sharp routes and speed had analysts calling him virtually uncoverable.

items.title: Sean McVay Stunned by NFL Players Returning to College Football
items.one_line: Rams coach Sean McVay stared in disbelief at NFL players heading back to college, blurting out, 'I feel like I took a freakin’ gummy.' His wide-eyed reaction captured the sheer weirdness of it all.

items.title: Raiders' Ashton Jeanty Suffers Mild Ankle Sprain in Practice
items.one_line: Ashton Jeanty dove for a low pass and landed awkwardly, needing help off the field as teammates knelt in prayer around him.

items.title: Raiders Wrap Training Camp with Cousins' Touchdowns and Depth Chart Reveal
items.one_line: Kirk Cousins lit up the field with a 55-yard touchdown bomb to Tre Tucker, capping a strong practice as rookies like Treydan Stukes earned key first-team reps.

items.title: Raiders Release Veteran Receiver Noah Brown After One Week
items.one_line: Noah Brown joined the Raiders' training camp hoping to catch on with a new team. Just over a week later, he was back on the market as an unrestricted free agent.

items.title: Dolphins Release Injured Lineman Jamaree Salyer with Settlement
items.one_line: Jamaree Salyer signed with the Dolphins hoping to claim a starting guard spot, but a knee injury and rising competition cut his time short.

items.title: Dolphins to Give Rookie Chris Bell Preseason Finale Shot
items.one_line: Rookie wide receiver Chris Bell has turned heads in camp, and now Coach Jeff Hafley plans to unleash him in Friday's finale against the Falcons—if practices stay sharp.

items.title: Giants Waive Ryan Miller; Dolphins Claim Him Off Waivers
items.one_line: Ryan Miller's NFL journey took a quick turn when the Giants let him go amid a crowded receiver room, only for the Dolphins to scoop him up the next day.

items.title: Vikings WR Jeshaun Jones Suspended Three Games for Substance Policy Violation
items.one_line: Jeshaun Jones had been turning heads in the preseason with standout catches, but now faces a three-game suspension right before roster cuts.

items.title: Vikings QB McCarthy Shares Reps with Wentz Amid Roster Pressure
items.one_line: J.J. McCarthy, the young No. 10 pick, split second-team reps with veteran Carson Wentz during Tuesday's practice, leaving fans watching his roster spot closely.

items.title: Saints Battle Injury Wave in Training Camp with Olave Scare
items.one_line: Chris Olave hit the turf hard on a deep pass and lay there for a moment, sending a ripple of worry through the New Orleans sideline.

items.title: Giants Trade Josh Ezeudu to Chiefs for 2028 Seventh-Round Pick
items.one_line: Josh Ezeudu, the versatile 6-foot-4 lineman, is heading to Kansas City after three seasons with the Giants. It's a pragmatic swap that turns depth into draft capital.

items.title: Giants List Rookie Skattebo as RB1 Ahead of Preseason Finale
items.one_line: Rookie Cam Skattebo tops the Giants' unofficial depth chart as RB1, with veterans like Najee Harris pushing hard for carries after his recent signing.

items.title: Giants Fans Eye Upset Over Cowboys in Season Opener
items.one_line: A fired-up Giants fan boldly predicted their team will 'absolutely dog' the Cowboys in Week 1, urging everyone to save the post. It's the kind of confident call that captures the electric buzz around this rivalry matchup.

items.title: Jets Name Jason Sanders Kicker, Waive Cade York
items.one_line: After a tight training camp battle, Jets special teams coach Chris Banjo had clear words: Jason Sanders has won the kicking job.

items.title: Eagles Receivers Lemon and Smith Return to Full Practice
items.one_line: Makai Lemon wasted no time, lining up with the starters and hauling in touchdowns on his first day back. Fans at Lincoln Financial Field felt the buzz with 40,000 packing the stands.

items.title: Rookie Lemon Scores on Wheel Route, Woolen Picks Off Hurts Twice at Eagles Practice
items.one_line: With fans packed into Lincoln Financial Field, rookie Makai Lemon lined up in the backfield and sprinted free for a touchdown on a clever wheel route from Jalen Hurts.

items.title: Steelers and Joey Porter Jr. Hit Contract Impasse as Trade Talk Swirls

items.title: Jalen Ramsey Backs Joey Porter Jr. in Steelers Contract Standoff
items.one_line: Jalen Ramsey stepped off the practice field and went straight to bat for his teammate Joey Porter Jr., calling for the Steelers to pay up amid a contract impasse.

items.title: Steelers Rookie Drew Allar Impresses in Preseason Debuts
items.one_line: Drew Allar stepped onto the field as a third-round rookie and immediately showed why Pittsburgh took a chance on him, firing deep passes with the poise of a veteran.

items.title: Seahawks Place Rookie Bud Clark and Mason Richman on Season-Ending IR
items.one_line: Coach Mike Macdonald called the injuries 'heartbreakers' after watching two promising rookies go down early in preseason against the Titans.

items.one_line: Jed York, San Francisco 49ers CEO and Youngstown native, drove to a mobile home park expecting a paid encounter—only to meet undercover officers instead.

items.title: Mike Evans Sidelined by Groin Injury as 49ers Training Camp Ends
items.one_line: Mike Evans pulled off his pads in frustration during practice, the latest soft-tissue setback for the new 49ers star as camp winds down.

items.title: 49ers Sign Bay Area Native Viliami Fehoko Jr. to One-Year Deal
items.one_line: Viliami Fehoko Jr., the East Palo Alto kid who starred at San Jose State, is heading home to the 49ers. It's a feel-good return for the pass-rush talent still chasing his first NFL snap.

items.title: Rookie Ted Hurst Outshines Travis Hunter in Joint Practice
items.one_line: Ted Hurst III, the Buccaneers' towering rookie receiver, repeatedly got the better of Jaguars star Travis Hunter during Tuesday's intense joint practice.

items.title: Texans Unveil H-Town Blue Rivalry Uniforms, Reviving Oilers Debate with Titans Fans
items.one_line: Houston's new uniforms pull straight from the city's blue mosaic tiles and street signs, stirring up old Oilers wounds with Titans fans who claim the history as their own.

items.title: Commanders Sign Pro Bowl Tackle D.J. Humphries After Tunsil Injury
items.one_line: Losing star left tackle Laremy Tunsil to a torn triceps left a big gap up front. The Commanders quickly turned to veteran D.J. Humphries, who worked out with them and signed on the spot.

items.title: Commanders Sell Limited Redskins Merch for Trademark Reasons
items.one_line: Fans spotted T-shirts with the old Redskins logo at the team store, honoring legends like Art Monk, Darrell Green, and Sean Taylor. The team insists it's just about protecting trademarks, not reviving the name.
